title: the order of the `is` checks decides the ambiguous case
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Same event, both shapes satisfied, opposite answers depending only on which `is` test is written first. The question resolves this by requiring Click to win, so that check has to come first.
